summary: Reviewed two attached Kyna lesson PDFs for 2026-10-23: Business English Beginner 1A 'Do you prefer to travel by car or by bus?' (11 pages) and Speaking Practice 'Food' (6 pages). Created verified, concise Vietnamese A1-A2 pre-class Markdown notes: /mnt/data/kyna_transport_prefer_car_or_bus_study_notes.md (204 lines) and /mnt/data/kyna_speaking_practice_food_study_notes.md (231 lines). Transport notes cover bike/motorbike/subway/taxi/helicopter, feelings, -ed/-ing, prefer constructions, 12 teacher follow-ups, dialogs, practice and answer keys; listening blanks clearly marked unverified predictions without audio. Food notes include all 20 original discussion questions with sample answers, six original food riddles, 10 patterns, 12 extra questions, dialogs and quick drills. Content distinguishes original PDF-derived material from added suggestions and avoids claiming example personal details as facts.
